correctness.rationale: For E=ell_1^n the published weak-p constraint maximizes at signed coordinate vectors, giving sum_j |u_i^j|^p<=1. Each positive test row chooses an active edge and its p-power minimum, producing a feasible fractional matching of no larger support. Conversely every feasible matching creates edge-supported test vectors with identical objective and support. An extreme LP optimizer has <=n positive edges by incidence-column dependence and two-sided perturbation. Odd-cycle saturation forces all weights 1/2; Fano incidence Gram 2I+J forces unique weight 1/3 and sharp sigma=7. Independent incidence checks passed; finite graphs do not prove general statement, which follows from the two-sided mapping.
